content: Jacob-kenh alerikw-rnemel renh awenng-warl akwerneyel
Joseph ra artnek-anem aynikw-anem atnyenek, arrwantyek.
Egypt-areny akalty ingkerrenh anek, arrewaly anterel apernetyek. Rernem arlta 40-ek-atwety alakenh-anyem mpwarek.
Rernem atnalhelerrenh arlta 70-ek-atwety artwamp ikweran. Joseph-el artwa ilanthek arrewaly renh anterel apernetyek rag-el ataperrelemel.
Rernemarl amperrngirrek-penh, Joseph Egypt-areny Atyetyart-rnem-warl angkek, “Arrantherr apek atyeng inkwerelhentyan, arrantherr Pharaoh renh ayernenherr-arey.
Akngey atyenh ilweyew-athath, atha renh alhelek, intey apmer Canaan-itwek renh akwernetyek.”
Pharaoh-el renh ilek, “Akngey ngkwenh akwerna, ntwarl renh ilek-angkwarr-antey akwernetyek.” ...
... Jacob-kenh alerikw-rnemel irrkaty-angkwarr mpwarek, rarl renh-rnem ilek-angkwarr-antey.
Apmer irrkaty Machpelah intey ikwer-itwek-antey Abraham-el Ephron, Hitt-kenh payemelek-itwek, renh akwernek.
Rernemarl atnalhelirrek-penh awayenheng rernem Egypt-warl-anem alpek.
Joseph-el awayikw ikwerenh-rnem ileyel
Aynikw ikwerenh-rnem-kenh ilwek-penhan rernem angkerrenh, “Joseph anwekingkerr ahelirrekerr wenh, ra anwenhingkerr atwekerr.”
Rernem thwenek artwa angkakert Joseph ikwer-warl. Ra iley-alhek, “Aynaynwekingkerr ilwey-alentyel, wetharl anwekingkerr ilerlelpek,
‘Arringkerr Joseph ayernetyek, mwerrant-arey arringkerr anetyek, arringkerrarl apmwel-areth ikwer anenh.’” Ra angka awek-penh, Joseph artnek-anem.
Awayikw ikwerenh-rnem ikwer-warl apetyek, angkey-alhemel, “Anwingkerr ngkwenh warrkenh-anemarl.”
Joseph-el renh-rnem ilek, “Aterirrey-angenh. Ayengan Akngey-wenyarl.
Arringkerr atyeng ilkelhey-angenh irrek Egypt-areny-rnem ayenh anthemel. Akngeyel ayenh arntarnt-arekarl. Atyeng-angkwarran Akngeyel ikwerenh-rnem arntarnt-arek, itethilek.
Alakenh-anyem-kety arringkerr aterirrey-angenh anetyek. Atharl arrenhingkerr arntarnt-arem, aler arrekingkerrenh-rnem-then. Ikwer-penhan rernem mwerrant-arey-anem anenh.”
Joseph ilweyel
Joseph apmer Egypt ikwer-itwek anenh, awayikw-rnem-akert. Joseph aherrety 110 anenh, artwa ampwanem.
Ra Ephraim-kenh arreng-rnem arek, Manasseh-kenh alerikw Makir.
Joseph ra awayikw ikwerenh-rnem ilelhek, “Arrer-anem ayeng ilwetyek-anem. Akngeyel anwenhingkerr arntarnt-arem, apmer rarl Abraham ingkerrenh alhelek ikwer-warl, Abraham-ek, Isaac-ek, Jacob-ek.”

Rap renh-rnem ilek, “Arringkerr arraty ayenh iletyek. Ayeng ilwenty, arrewaly ayenh aknga Akngeyel arrenhingkerr atnwenheyneyel apmer Canaan ikwer-warl, ikwer-itwek akwernetyek.” Kel rernem renh arraty ilek.
Joseph aherrety 110 irrekel-anem, ra ilwek. Rernem arrewaly anterel-anem apernek, rag-el ataperrelemel, coffin-warl arrernemel.
